title: A prompt built from a skill's text keeps that skill's caveats
why: The retrospective's 21:16 CST paste prompt to Degen and Home dropped the ci-hygiene skill's "Unverified: R61 part 3" caveat and told child repos to stop push suites; that is how Degen's PR 708 got the no-merge-onto-red-main hole.
note: Mistake: a prompt built from an unmerged skill's text left out its caveats. No guard holds it. Fix candidate: a prompt or brief that quotes a skill carries every "Unverified:" line of the quoted section, checked when the message is sent. A note until it repeats, or a guard if cheap. Triage 23:18 CST Nov 12: stays todo, not ready. Its own note makes it a note until the mistake repeats.
